title: Diagram of two objects' sequential positions (1)–(4) with north arrows and heading
description: Typed schematic showing small circles representing two objects at four numbered stages with explanations: "(1) First one object was sighted, next, another one appeared"; "(2) When first seen objects were in a semi-stationary position"; "(3) Objects began moving in a NNE direction and rapidly accelerating and climbing"; "(4) In approximately 2 minutes objects had disappeared". Hand-drawn N–S lines and arrows indicate orientation, annotated "left on this heading". CONFIDENTIAL stamps are struck through.
